annotations.title: Buy a server appraisal by card

description: Buy a fresh appraisal of one domain, computed on this server, for $5 by card. Use it when appraise_domain answered notAppraised and the user wants the figure returned to you rather than opened in their browser. This is the price for a person paying by card; an agent account an operator has funded pays the lower stored-appraisal price instead (https://audit.domains/machine-account). Returns checkoutUrl (a Square payment page for the user: no account, no sign-in), orderId and orderToken. Give checkoutUrl to the user; after they pay, call appraisal_order_status with orderId and orderToken. Keep orderToken: it is shown once and is the only proof of purchase. A paid order that cannot be delivered is refunded in full.

domain.description: The domain to appraise, e.g. brightcargo.com.
